Description: Batch processes approved guarantee applications to generate LoG PDFs. Uses SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED to claim batches (limit: GUARANTEE_APPLICATION_PROCESS_LIMIT, default 15). Sets processing=true to prevent concurrent processing. For each: fetches signatories by role, downloads signature images, fetches product-specific LoG template, renders PDF with embedded signatures, uploads to file server, creates LOGInvoiceJobStatus record, async-fires invoice generation. On failure releases claim.
Criticality Reason: LoG generation produces the legally binding guarantee letter. Database-level locking (SKIP LOCKED) for concurrency. Multiple external service dependencies per application (Auth, Config, File, Payment, iBank APEX). Batch failures can leave applications in processing=true limbo. Signature embedding requires role-based staff lookup.
Important Log Fields: batch_size, applications_processed, applications_failed, signatory_roles, template_source, processing_duration_ms, trace_id, span_id
Sensitive Data: Signatory signature URLs, TIN, settlement accounts, borrower details embedded in LoG PDF.
Dependencies: DB: Guarantee.Applications (SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), Guarantee.GuaranteeLetterDocuments (create), Guarantee.LOGInvoiceJobStatus (create). HTTP: Auth Service (signatory lookup by role), Configuration Service (template), File Management Service (PDF + signature uploads), Payment Service (invoice), iBank APEX (settlement account).
Observability Gap: SECURITY: Endpoint is unprotected. No batch processing metrics. No stuck-processing detection. No per-application failure tracking in metrics. Critical batch job with no alerting capability.
Notes: SECURITY: Public endpoint that generates legally binding documents with embedded signatures. Must add authentication. Customer-facing: No (internal batch). SKIP LOCKED concurrency is a good pattern.

Observability Gap: SECURITY: Endpoint is unprotected. No invoice resolution metrics. No alerting on FAILED invoices. No visibility into retry exhaustion.

Description: Complex multi-PFI processing. Parses Excel, groups by LoG reference -> PFI. Batch lookups PFIs. Validates user authorization per PFI. Sensitive Data: JWT token. Multi-PFI loan performance data. PFI identity cross-references.
Dependencies: DB: Guarantee.IndividualGuaranteeReports (multi-create in transaction), Guarantee.IndividualReportData (bulk upserts). HTTP: File Management Service, Workflow Service (multiple start calls), Profile Service (batch PFI lookups), Access Management Service (guard).
Observability Gap: No consolidated report metrics. No per-PFI processing tracking. No data isolation verification logging. 207 Multi-Status responses not tracked.
Notes: Customer-facing: Yes. Returns 207 Multi-Status. Most complex endpoint in ECGF. Data isolation between PFIs is critical.
